definitions.ask: Should a Ctrl+Tab round trip out of a Highlights-key session come back to that session's Tabs view?
definitions.why: Leaving Refs never saves a Highlights-key session; Ctrl+Tab restores what the hotkeys restore

choices.label: Ctrl+Tab away ends the session; switching back shows the view from before the Highlights key
Ctrl+Tab back returns to the session's Tabs view; only hiding Refs ends the session

definitions.ask: Should every Tabs entry, not only the Highlights key, preselect the focused PDF?
definitions.why: The request names the Highlights keymap; the in-panel switcher rule is documented behavior

choices.label: Only the Highlights-key show selects it; in-panel Command-T keeps the previous-tab preselection
Every Tabs preselection selects the focused PDF; the previous-tab rule is removed

definitions.ask: Should we add a decisions record that a Highlights-key Tabs session is ephemeral and opens on the focused page?
